loop_invariant: At the start of iteration i: total == sum(arr[0:i])

proof_structure.initialization: Before first iteration: i=0, total=0, sum(arr[0:0])=0. Invariant holds.
proof_structure.maintenance: If total == sum(arr[0:i]) at start, then after total += arr[i] and i += 1, total == sum(arr[0:i+1]). Invariant preserved.
proof_structure.termination: Loop exits when i == len(arr). Invariant gives total == sum(arr[0:len(arr)]) == sum(arr). Correct.
